description: Ask Immiscible before every Bash command, file edit, web fetch and MCP call. Reads IMMISCIBLE_URL and IMMISCIBLE_AGENT_KEY from the environment or the project's .env (npx immiscible init writes them). Fails closed. Immiscible's own read-only tools (check_action_status, explain_decision, spend_summary, find_waste, unwatched_keys) are not sent to it again.
